Description: A gatekeeper run is judged on stating a decision, citing the conditions that produced it, telling the requester how to come back, and never waiving the gate it exists to hold.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Stated a decision
Criteria.Statement: A gatekeeper that does not decide leaves the ticket stalled.

Criteria.Name: Cited the blocking conditions
Criteria.Statement: A refusal must name the conditions that produced it.

Criteria.Name: Told the requester how to return
Criteria.Statement: A refusal without a path back is an escalation, not a gate.

Criteria.Name: Did not waive the gate
Criteria.Statement: The gate was waived rather than held.
